# Coverage for the fast suite, gated in CI with --cov-fail-under (see
# pytest.ini and .github/workflows/ci.yml). Pinned so the reported number
# cannot drift under us. Opt-in on the command line, not addopts — measuring
# slows the fast inner loop that `pytest tests/` is deliberately kept quick for.

# Property-based coverage of every documented API operation
# (tests/test_openapi_contract.py).
# schemathesis pulls three dependencies with no upper bound, and a fresh CI
# install resolved onto a jsonschema-rs that broke it: 188 of 197 contract tests
# failed with
#     AttributeError: 'builtins.CanonicalSchema' object has no attribute 'is_satisfiable'
# while the same suite passed locally. `CanonicalSchema` is the PyO3 class from
# jsonschema-rs (hence the `builtins` module in that message), schemathesis
# calls `canonical.is_satisfiable()` at
# specs/openapi/_hypothesis.py:1209, and 0.50.0 dropped the method that 0.49.2
# has. Same reasoning as the starlette pin in requirements.txt: pin the
# transitive dependency whose break we have actually been bitten by.
# Stay on the 0.49.x line: 0.51.0 is current upstream but the method is still
# gone, so patch releases within 0.49 are the only safe move here.
jsonschema-rs==0.49.9 \
